topics.lesson_subject: Hashed URL and SNI threat feeds for Web Filter

Web Filter profile references the category
Known positive indicator logs expected category/action; benign control remains allowed

Verify HTTPS certificate, source interface/IP, DNS, route and refresh
Bind the external-resource category to the active Web Filter profile
topics.question_fingerprint: Hash feed object mode/category/refresh state versus Web Filter profile binding and observed URL/SNI match.
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: FortiGate pulls hash feed -> parses hash database -> Web Filter profile binds category -> URL/SNI observation -> match/action.

topics.lesson_subject: MCLAG inter-chassis link failure and split-brain prevention
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: FortiSwitch MCLAG uses an inter-chassis link (ICL) between two peers and a dual-homed LACP trunk; split-brain detection makes one peer dormant if the ICL fails while both peers remain active.
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Configure ICL and MCLAG trunks -> downstream LACP member links -> peer state synchronization -> ICL failure detection -> priority/MAC tie-break -> one peer dormant -> restore when ICL/LACP returns.
topics.failure_class: ICL trunk down while both peers forward; inconsistent trunk or VLAN configuration; split-brain detection disabled; wrong priority; third-party topology limitations.
evidence_pattern: ICL LACP state and peer communication
MCLAG split-brain detection/priority
Dormant peer state and recovery after ICL restoration
remediation_path: Restore ICL physical/LACP connectivity
Enable split-brain detection and supported priority/all-ports-down behavior
Verify dual-homed downstream LAG and version/topology caveats
topics.question_fingerprint: Distinguish a peer failure from an ICL-only failure and predict which peer becomes dormant.
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Switch A <-> ICL LACP <-> Switch B; downstream switch dual-homed LACP; on split brain one peer dormant.
